description: Copy of the Phase-1 benchmark with ECAD and DEXPI filter identifiers grounded in AAST sample; execution against compiled property paths remains pending.
grounding_note: ECAD Pressure and PI-1301 were observed together on the same device in AAST GraphDB; the exact compiled class/property paths and expected result sets have NOT yet been verified. DEXPI R-001 and K-001 were observed with dexpi:hasLocalId but are not yet confirmed to belong to the Equipment root class used by compiled queries. This remains a candidate benchmark, not a proven nonzero fixture.
